root_cause.statement: Enhanced used a bounded, mechanism-relevant Teaching retrieval pack, but the actual Baseline already withheld recovery credit without a retained-network economics and cash/capital bridge. The memory improved neither a material economic treatment nor a distinct rank-one research action.

economic_retention: This is evidence against pretending that a generic mechanism card is automatically active learning. It does not show that the target company lacks value or that Teaching is useless; it shows that this card pair did not add incremental treatment beyond an already competent baseline.
next_action: Pause repetitive paired-Holdout construction. Return to outcome-isolated Blind feedback and select the next learning intervention only from an observed, material blind reasoning failure or a feedback-derived behavior that an actual new pre-outcome application changes. A future Holdout tests that specific applied behavior rather than a generic rule or generic card retrieval.
